web.label: Let the Agent look things up online
web.description: When on, the Agent can search the sites turned on below to check how names, places and terms are translated. Only search words and page links are sent; your subtitles and translation materials never are.

sources.title: Sources
sources.note: None of these sites need an account or key. Page content is treated as reference only: the Agent always asks before saving to your translation materials, and entries found online start as needing review.

wikipedia.name: Wikipedia
wikipedia.description: The first place to look, for general topics. Chinese, Japanese and English.

moegirl.name: Moegirlpedia (mirror)
moegirl.description: Anime, games, characters and other ACG topics. The official site limits programmatic access, so it is read through the moegirl.uk mirror.

baidu_baike.name: Baidu Baike
baidu_baike.description: Summaries and info boxes of Chinese entries.

biligame.name: Bilibili game wikis
biligame.description: Character, place and item names in a game. Needs a wiki code.

bing.name: Bing search
bing.description: General web search; can be limited to a game’s official site to find official translations.

biligame.label: Bilibili game wiki codes
biligame.hint: A code is the path in the address, as in wiki.biligame.com/zzz. Separate with commas; the first is the default.
biligame.invalid: Not a valid code: {{codes}}. Use lowercase letters, digits, underscores and hyphens only.

sessions.label: Conversation history
sessions.description: Agent conversations are saved in the app's data folder on this computer, so you can continue them from the list on the home page after a restart. {{count}} saved.
sessions.clear_description: Every saved Agent conversation and its messages will be deleted permanently. This can't be undone, and replies in progress will stop.
sessions.clear_failed: Couldn't delete everything; some conversation files may remain on disk

enable.label: Allow external agents to connect
enable.description: Claude Code, Codex and other agents can read and work in FusionKit over MCP and do the translating themselves, so no API key is needed here. Listens on this computer only (127.0.0.1) and requires the token.

read_only.name: Read only
read_only.description: Read state, subtitles and translation materials; change nothing.

confirm_writes.name: Ask before changes
confirm_writes.description: Imports, written translations, exports and other changes need your OK in FusionKit; you can allow a kind of change for the rest of a connection.

auto.name: Automatic
auto.description: Changes run right away; replacing existing files and changing translation materials still ask.

clients.title: Connect a client
clients.stdio_only: The Claude app (Claude Desktop) reaches local servers through stdio only
clients.disabled: Turn on “Allow external agents to connect” to get a configuration you can copy.

claude-code.step1: Terminal: run the command below once.
claude-code.step2: The desktop app (the Code tab in Claude) shares this configuration; start a new local session to use it. Without the terminal version, write the configuration from the Claude app tab instead: local Code sessions read it too.
claude-code.step3: Type /mcp in a session to check that fusionkit is connected.

claude-desktop.step1: Custom connectors in Claude Desktop connect from the cloud and cannot reach this computer, so FusionKit goes into claude_desktop_config.json as a stdio server.
claude-desktop.step2: Click “Write to config file”, or in Claude open Settings → Developer → Edit Config and merge the content below.
claude-desktop.step3: Quit Claude completely (from the tray or menu bar) and open it again. Local Code sessions in the Claude app use it too.

codex.step1: The terminal, desktop app and IDE extension share ~/.codex/config.toml.
codex.step2: Click “Write to config file”, or add the content below to config.toml. The desktop app's Settings → MCP servers → Add server form has no fields for headers or environment variables, so use the file.
codex.step3: In the desktop app, click Restart under Settings → MCP servers; restart codex in the terminal.

cursor.step1: Click “Add to Cursor”: the Cursor desktop app opens and asks you to confirm the installation.
cursor.step2: Or click “Write to config file” to add it to ~/.cursor/mcp.json (every project); for one project only, put the content below in that project's .cursor/mcp.json.
cursor.step3: Check that fusionkit is enabled under Customize in Cursor's sidebar (Settings → MCP in older versions); restart Cursor if it does not appear.

json.step1: For other MCP clients: merge the JSON below into their MCP configuration (mcpServers).
json.step2: If the client adds servers through a form, fill in the fields below one by one.
json.step3: HTTP needs a client that can send a request header; otherwise use stdio.

guide.stdio: stdio goes through a small program that ships with FusionKit and starts FusionKit when it is not running.

skill.title: Bundled skill
skill.description: The skill tells external agents how to use FusionKit (translation workflow, confirmations and errors). It takes effect in new conversations. Claude Code reads ~/.claude/skills; Codex, Cursor and other agents read the shared ~/.agents/skills.
skill.install_agents: Install for Codex, Cursor and others
skill.outdated: An older version is installed; install again to update: {{path}}

confirm.title: {{client}} wants to {{action}}

summary.import: Import the subtitles in {{count}} paths into Subtitle Studio.
summary.write_translations: Write {{count}} translations to “{{track}}” in “{{document}}”, marked as unreviewed AI translations. You can undo this in Subtitle Studio.
summary.export_source: Export “{{document}}” as {{format}} ({{content}}) to the original file’s folder.
summary.export_choose: Export “{{document}}” as {{format}} ({{content}}); you choose where to save it next.
summary.transcription: Transcribe the audio and video in {{count}} paths into Subtitle Studio with the local model {{model}}.
summary.knowledge: Save {{count}} translation material changes. They are enabled right away.
summary.split_cue: Split line {{number}} of “{{document}}” in two at {{time}}. Other tracks’ translations of it are marked as made for an older source. You can undo this in Subtitle Studio.
summary.insert_cue_before: Insert a new line before line {{number}} of “{{document}}” ({{time}}). You can undo this in Subtitle Studio.
summary.insert_cue_after: Insert a new line after line {{number}} of “{{document}}” ({{time}}). You can undo this in Subtitle Studio.
summary.convert_source: Convert {{count}} subtitle files to {{format}} and save each next to its original; existing names get a number.
summary.convert_directory: Convert {{count}} subtitle files to {{format}} and save them in “{{directory}}”; existing names get a number.
summary.extract_source: Keep only {{language}} from {{count}} bilingual subtitle files; the new files go next to the originals, and existing names get a number.
summary.extract_directory: Keep only {{language}} from {{count}} bilingual subtitle files and save the new files in “{{directory}}”; existing names get a number.
summary.rename_paths: Rename the {{count}} files or folders below to the names the external agent gave. Runs deepest first and restores everything if a step fails; can be undone afterwards.
summary.undo_rename: Undo an earlier rename by the external agent and give the files and folders their old names back.

confirm.overwrite_warning: A file with the same name will be replaced. This cannot be undone.
confirm.allow_session: Allow this kind of action for the rest of this connection
